test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Which of the following is correct?

options.text: The Vice-President is elected for a term of five years.
The Vice-President is elected for a term of four years.
The Vice-President is elected for a term of seven years.
The Vice-President is elected for a term of six years.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Vice-President is elected for a term of five years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** vice president **is the** ex officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha**.
 
• **Article 66 **of the Indian constitution is related to the election of the vice president.
 
• The vice presiden**t holds office for five years.**
 
• The Vice-President is chosen by** an electoral college comprised of members of both Houses of Parliament **using the single transferable vote in line with the proportional representation system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Electoral College for the post of Vice-President is made up **of all members of both Houses of Parliament***
 
• If a member of either House of Parliament or a House of a State Legislature is elected Vice-President, he is regarded to have relinquished his position in that House on the day of his election.
